Hi — I'm the product manager for our API platform team. We're preparing the public-facing release notes for version 2.4.0, which is going out to customers next week.

Our engineering team dumped all the raw commit data into a file at `project/docs/raw_v2.4.0_commits.txt`. It's a mess — it has everything from security patches to internal refactors to some commits that are genuinely ambiguous and need a human to review before we can say anything public about them.

I need you to produce a clean, properly structured customer-facing changelog document named `changelog_v2.4.0.md`. The document should clearly separate what customers will actually care about from the internal engineering work. Anything that's ambiguous or incomplete should be flagged separately so our team can review it before we publish.

Please make sure the version header, all sections, and the content are properly formatted and complete — our legal team will be checking that known limitations and any breaking changes are explicitly called out.
